summary: News Corporation filed a routine Form 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) on October 8, 2026, reporting daily ASX disclosures tied to its previously authorized repurchase program of up to $1 billion in aggregate Class A and Class B common stock. No new repurchase authorization, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation was disclosed. The filing satisfies Australian Securities Exchange daily transaction disclosure requirements and includes Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2 with date-stamped information. As an ordinary buyback program update, it lacks a special-situation catalyst; monitor actual repurchase volumes, pricing, and remaining authorization rather than event-driven arbitrage.
